user.title: Connect Home Assistant MCP
user.description: {detected}. Use the MCP server on THIS Home Assistant instance with the Assist API and Control Home Assistant enabled. The URL is suggested automatically; enter a long-lived access token from your profile. [Set up MCP](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/config_flow/?domain=mcp_server).

engine.title: Connect the local Truss engine
engine.description: Start the Truss engine on Windows, Docker, or Home Assistant OS and wait for 'Truss models are ready'. Enter the engine computer's LAN address, for example http://192.168.1.50:10350, and its pairing token. Choose bundled live transcription or a compatible streaming server. Standard Whisper upload and Ollama chat endpoints are not compatible. Select Laya or Jev in the engine configuration; Jev requires your TypeSafe API key there. Restart the engine after switching, then reload this integration.

data.stt_url: External STT WebSocket URL (external mode only)

actions.title: Choose devices
actions.description: Select the devices for your chosen mode. The scope must contain 1–24 entities. Devices must be exposed in Settings > Voice assistants > Expose. Automatic modes refresh each utterance.

selection.title: Choose how Truss finds devices
selection.description: Choose a device selection mode. The next screen shows only the relevant room or entity picker. All supported Assist entities requires no individual selection.

error.cannot_connect_mcp: Could not discover compatible MCP tools. Check this HA instance's URL, token, Assist API, and Control Home Assistant setting.
error.cannot_connect_engine: Engine unavailable, models not ready, or invalid streaming endpoint. Check app logs, URL, and token.
error.entity_count: The scope must contain 1–24 entities. Choose fewer rooms or use manual selection if it exceeds 24. For automatic modes, expose supported devices to Assist first.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Truss is already configured. Use its Configure button to change settings.

init.title: Configure Truss Live Voice
init.description: Changing settings reconnects Truss and stops active sessions. Choose the device selection mode here, then continue to its room or entity picker. To switch Laya/Jev, change decision_backend in the engine configuration and enter typesafe_api_key for Jev. Restart the engine, then reload Truss; the selected model is detected automatically.
